cause: the unit runs the app as a script path (python3 /opt/room/app/station.py), so its own directory comes first on sys.path and the release's app/operator.py shadows the standard library's operator: the interpreter's own imports fail (cannot import name … from 'operator' (/opt/room/app/operator.py)); the module is the app's and is needed
cures_ok: a drop-in under /etc/systemd/system/patient-room.service.d that runs it as a module (ExecStart= then ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m app.station), daemon-reload, restart
the same with python3 -P, which leaves the script's directory off sys.path
